{{Current events|year=2026|month=06|day=12|content=

<!-- All news items below this line --> 
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[2026 Iran war]]
**[[2025–2026 Iran–United States negotiations]]
***[[2026 Iran war ceasefire]]
****[[Pakistan in the 2026 Iran war]]
*****[[Pakistan]]i [[Prime Minister of Pakistan|prime minister]] [[Shehbaz Sharif]] says that a [[ceasefire]] deal between [[Iran]] and the [[United States]] has a "final, agreed upon text" to end the war. [https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/12/iran-deal-trump-pakistan-sharif.html (CNBC)]
****[[Minister of Foreign Affairs (Iran)|Iranian foreign minister]] [[Abbas Araghchi]] says that a ceasefire deal with the U.S. to extend the ceasefire, reopen the [[Strait of Hormuz]], and launch negotiations on the [[Nuclear program of Iran|Iranian nuclear program]] has "never been closer". [https://www.axios.com/2026/06/12/iran-deal-us-ceasefire-signing (''Axios'')]
**[[2026 Strait of Hormuz crisis]]
***[[2026 Strait of Hormuz campaign]]
****The [[United States Central Command]] says that [[United States Armed Forces|American forces]] have intercepted multiple Iranian drones targeting commercial ships in the [[Strait of Hormuz]]. They also reaffirm that the "international trade corridor remains open for transit". [https://www.haaretz.com/middle-east-news/2026-06-13/ty-article/.premium/u-s-military-says-it-downed-iranian-drones-targeting-hormuz-shipping/0000019e-bfd6-dd0a-a19f-bffec2250000 (Haaretz)] [https://thehill.com/policy/defense/5922688-us-forces-down-iranian-drones/ (''The Hill'')]
***Iranian foreign minister Abbas Araghchi says that the [[Strait of Hormuz]] will not return to the way it was before the war, that it will be under Iranian and [[Oman]]i sovereignty, and will have a fee. [https://aje.news/ze5vzt?update=4651859 (Al Jazeera)]
*[[War on drugs#War on cartels (2025–present)|War on cartels]]
**[[Operation Southern Spear]]
***[[President of the United States|U.S. president]] [[Donald Trump]] announces that a joint U.S.–[[Venezuela]] operation has killed [[Tren de Aragua]] leader [[Niño Guerrero]]. [https://www.politico.com/news/2026/06/12/us-kills-venezuelas-tren-de-aragua-leader-in-military-strike-trump-says-00961269?cid=apn (''Politico'')]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Initial public offering of SpaceX]]
**Businessman [[Elon Musk]] [[Wealth of Elon Musk|becomes]] the world's first [[United States dollar|U.S.-dollar]] [[trillionaire]] after his company [[SpaceX]] debuts on the [[Nasdaq stock market]]. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-06-12/elon-musk-hits-1-trillion-net-worth-as-spacex-ipo-breaks-records (''Bloomberg'')] [https://www.reuters.com/business/media-telecom/spacex-ipo-makes-elon-musk-worlds-first-trillionaire-2026-06-11/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Eight people are killed after a bus veered off a cliff in [[Kavrepalanchok]], [[Nepal]]. [https://english.news.cn/20260612/835814534f2a4564afd11ba53fb0f19d/c.html (Xinhua)]
*One person is killed, and twenty-two others are injured after a tent collapses at a church event in [[Moneta, Virginia|Moneta]], [[Virginia]], United States. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/americas/1-dead-22-injured-as-storm-topples-church-celebration-tent-in-virginia/3965874 (AA)] [https://apnews.com/article/church-tent-collapse-virginia-death-injuries-a52c5e0ad82e8867065e1d3d5df4aa84 (AP)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[2026 Kent meningitis outbreak]]
**Health authorities in the [[United Kingdom]] launch a [[vaccine|vaccination]] program against the [[Meningitis B]] virus in the wake of an outbreak that occurred at the [[University of Kent]] in [[Kent]], [[England]], killed two people. [https://www.reuters.com/business/healthcare-pharmaceuticals/uk-launches-one-off-menb-vaccination-programme-wake-largest-outbreak-2026-06-12/ (Reuters)]
**[[Northern Ireland|Northern Irish]] [[Department of Health (Northern Ireland)|health minister]] [[Mike Nesbitt]] announces that students aged up to 25 in [[Northern Ireland]] will be offered the [[Meningococcal vaccine|meningitis vaccine]] in the wake of the outbreak at the University of Kent. [https://www.irishnews.com/news/northern-ireland/northern-ireland-students-to-receive-one-off-meningitis-vaccine-JHKLUCYHFJEC7HZ2JL7EV2FS4E/ (''Irish News'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2026 Midland shooting]]
**One person is killed, and ten others are injured in a [[Mass shootings in the United States|mass shooting]] at an abandoned veterinary clinic in [[Midland, Texas|Midland]], [[Texas]], United States. The suspect dies from a [[suicide by firearm|self-inflicted gunshot wound]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2026/06/12/us/midland-texas-active-shooter (CNN)]
*[[2024 South Korean martial law crisis]]
**Former [[South Korea]]n [[President of South Korea|president]] [[Yoon Suk Yeol]] is found guilty of [[treason]] and [[Corruption in South Korea|abuse of power]] for ordering drones to be flown into [[North Korea]] in order to provoke North Korea and help justify his martial law declaration, and is sentenced to 30 years imprisonment on top of a pre-existing [[Life imprisonment|life sentence]]. [https://cebudailynews.inquirer.net/736901/s-koreas-ex-president-gets-30-years-over-north-korea-drone-incident (AFP via ''Cebu Daily News'')] [https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10770486 (''The Korea Herald'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2025–2026 Indonesian protests]]
**Hundreds of students protest against [[Indonesia]]n [[President of Indonesia|president]] [[Prabowo Subianto]] prompted by a [[Energy in Indonesia|fuel]] price hike, [[Red and White Cabinet|governmental]] tensions, and mismanaged government spending on the [[Free Nutritious Meals]] program. [https://apnews.com/article/indonesia-students-protest-economic-pressures-fc758948bc547075d62bcf80d8a7e827 (AP)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/students-hold-heading-bankrupt-indonesia-protests-against-prabowos-policies-2026-06-12/ (Reuters)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Regulation of artificial intelligence in the United States]]
**The [[U.S. Department of Commerce]] orders [[artificial intelligence]] company [[Anthropic]] to ban non-Americans from accessing its [[large language model]]s [[Claude Mythos]] and [[Claude Fable 5|Fable 5]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c932g3v3e13o (BBC News)] [https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/12/anthropic-disables-access-to-fable-5-and-mythos-5-to-comply-with-government-directive.html (CNBC)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2026 FIFA World Cup]]
**[[List of 2026 FIFA World Cup controversies|2026 FIFA World Cup controversies]], [[Ghana at the FIFA World Cup]]
***[[Ghana]]ian midfielder [[Thomas Partey]] is denied a [[Visa policy of Canada|visa]] to enter [[Canada]], thus missing [[Ghana national football team|his team's]] World Cup opener against [[2026 FIFA World Cup Group L#Ghana vs Panama|Panama]] in [[Toronto]]. The [[Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada|IRCC]] cites ongoing legal proceedings stemming from charges of [[Sexual offences in the United Kingdom|rape]] and [[sexual assault]] in the UK. He has pled not guilty to all charges. [https://aje.news/dhhyc8 (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/7354492/2026/06/12/thomas-partey-banned-canada-ghana-world-cup/?source=athletic_user_shared_article_copylink&smid=url-share-ta (''The New York Times'')]
**[[Canada at the FIFA World Cup]], [[United States at the FIFA World Cup]]
***The [[2026 FIFA World Cup opening ceremony|opening ceremonies]] of the [[FIFA World Cup]] in [[Canada]] and the [[United States]] occur at the [[Toronto Stadium]] and [[SoFi Stadium]] in [[Inglewood, California|Inglewood]], [[California]], respectively. [https://www.theglobeandmail.com/sports/soccer/article-canada-vs-bosnia-herzegovina-score-world-cup-game-group-b-toronto/ (AFP via ''The Globe and Mail'')] [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c4g9g9xy9y7o (BBC News)] [https://www.fifa.com/en/tournaments/mens/worldcup/canadamexicousa2026/articles/stars-dazzle-toronto-los-angeles-ceremonies (FIFA)]
*** In their [[2026 FIFA World Cup Group B|opening match]], [[Canada men's national soccer team|Canada]] earn their first [[Three points for a win|point]] in World Cup history after drawing 1–1 with [[Bosnia and Herzegovina national football team|Bosnia and Herzegovina]]. [https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49044571/forget-canada-world-cup-hosts-bosnia-why-opening-draw-shows-their-world-cup-too (ESPN)]
**[[Israel at the FIFA World Cup]], [[Gaza war protests]]
***[[Palestinian nationalism|Pro-]][[Palestine|Palestinian]] protests are held near the Toronto Stadium, against [[FIFA]]'s association with [[Israel]]. Additionally, a red banner was displayed near the [[Gardiner Expressway]]. [https://www.reuters.com/sports/soccer/fifa-faces-protests-toronto-over-israel-ties-ahead-canada-world-cup-match-2026-06-12/ (Reuters)]
